A Techmeme excerpt of Bloomberg reporting says KKR-backed Helix Digital is discussing a purchase of EdgeCore at a multibillion-dollar valuation. The original article and transaction documents were inaccessible.

An attributed valuation range during talks is not an agreed price or completed transfer. Financing, debt treatment, approvals and final ownership were not verified from the excerpt.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed transaction report
Parties are described as holding talks
Enterprise and equity basis was not verified
